claim_boundary: Baseline A is a team release package and screening pathfinder. It is not final aircraft sign-off, not adhesive sign-off, not laminate sign-off, and not manufacturing sign-off.
current_pathfinder_role: Baseline A team release pathfinder, not final aircraft

frozen.phase_j_pipeline: Mission contract -> Fourier-AVL -> smooth geometry -> loaded-Z -> AVL recheck -> Tier2 airfoil -> aero-structure closure -> FEM/APDL

open_validation.c04_coupon: saddle/yoke/clamp coupon plus lug-foot shear and clamp retention
open_validation.carbon_tube_rfq: vendor tube capability, tolerances, laminate, and splice fit
open_validation.one_meter_wing_bay_v2: rib/collar/skin-sag bay test on physical spacing
open_validation.p1_local_load_path: coupon/local FEM required before build sign-off
open_validation.qualified_aero_surface_mapping: direct spar-pair stress-test is not final

reopen_triggers: C04 saddle/yoke/clamp coupon or local FEM shows negative governing margin.
Updated mass/CG cannot hold managed CG 0.75 m within rebalance limit.
Tube vendor-screening evidence cannot meet main/rear spar OD, wall, tolerance, or splice-fit assumptions after authority repair.
Qualified aero-surface mapping invalidates the current direct stress-test warning read after authority repair.
Tail trim/stability or control authority fails at managed CG.
Main-wing bounded SU2 calibration changes drag/power enough to invalidate mission margins.
Manufacturing discretization forces large external-shape or spar-spec change.
